name: wrong-layout-input
title: Wrong Layout Input
description: Text input that catches text typed in the wrong keyboard layout (Russian, Hebrew, Greek, Hindi InScript against US QWERTY) using letter-pair models, offers the retyped text as a one-tap fix with undo, and leaves names, acronyms, links and code alone.

meta.stops: Text typed in the wrong keyboard layout
meta.summary: Notices text typed with the wrong keyboard layout ("ghbdtn" for "привет") and offers the retyped text as a one-tap fix.
catches: Latin gibberish that is a word in another layout (ghbdtn → привет)
Non-Latin gibberish that is English in QWERTY (руддщ → hello)
Words no real language would spell
Names, acronyms, links, code and your ignore list, left alone
limits: Only the layouts you pass, each mapped against US QWERTY
Statistical: short words can be missed or wrongly flagged
a11y: Visible <label>; hint via aria-describedby in a polite live region
Use button has an aria-label with the converted text; converted text gets a lang attribute
Keep and undo are labelled; focus returns to the input
